name: @refineui/utilities
description: RefineUI React utilities for building components

scripts.build: pnpm run build:color && pnpm run build:animation
scripts.build:color: pnpm exec tsup src/color.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean --out-dir lib --external react --external react-dom
scripts.build:animation: pnpm exec tsup src/animation.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --out-dir lib --external react --external react-dom
